$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.grammar.mermaid. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-MERMAID-PLAIN-LT-RAW
arms.note: a plain label's `<` is written raw, so Mermaid reads it as markup: `Array<String>` loses its tag-shaped half and `<b>` renders bold

arms.name: M-MERMAID-PLAIN-AMP-RAW
arms.note: a plain label's `&` is written raw, so the text `"` renders as a quote and an escape written after a raw `&` completes a reference that re-reads as markup

arms.name: M-MERMAID-TICK-UNESCAPED
arms.note: a quoted label opening with a backtick is written as a markdown string opener, and a backtick inside a markdown string closes it early

arms.name: M-MERMAID-CODEPOINT-UNBOUNDED
arms.find: return code == null || code < 1 || code > MAX_CODE_POINT || (code >= SURROGATE_FIRST && code <= SURROGATE_LAST) ? null : code;
arms.note: a numeric code outside Unicode reaches String.fromCharCode and throws a RangeError, and a surrogate decodes to half a character

arms.name: M-MERMAID-INLINE-TAKES-PREFIX
arms.note: a bare solid-edge label stops at markup without asking for its closing link, so plain takes the prefix before the space and `A -- a < b --> E` no longer parses

arms.name: M-MERMAID-NUMERIC-REF-RAW
arms.note: markup writes a numeric HTML reference raw, and Mermaid, which turns every `#\w+;` into a reference whatever precedes it, renders `<` as `&<`

arms.name: M-MERMAID-CODE-ALPHABET-NARROW
arms.note: a code name may not hold `_`, so plain text `#a_b;` is written unescaped and Mermaid renders it as the reference `&a_b;`

arms.name: M-MERMAID-DOTTED-TEXT-TAKES-DOTS
arms.note: a bare dotted-edge label takes every dot but the one before the `-`, so `-. text ..->` reads the label `text .` where Mermaid's lexer closes the link at `..->`
